canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas; its chrome strip along the window top shows three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; the app content sits inside its white content area below the chrome strip.

layers.description: App header band across the top of the white content area: on the left the bold dark heading "Kanban board"; on the right a rounded text input with grey placeholder text "Add a card…" followed by a blue rounded button with white label "Add".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the browser window content area, above the three board columns.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "To Do" at its top, holding a vertical stack of three plain white card rows separated by thin dividers, each row showing only its dark title: "Write weekly report", "Fix login redirect", and "Buy milk". Only the third row, "Buy milk", additionally shows controls at its right edge: a small grey text "Edit" and a red bold hovered text "Delete", indicating the pointer is about to delete that card; the first two rows show no controls.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Leftmost of three equal board columns arranged side by side with equal gaps.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "In Progress" at its top, holding a vertical stack of two plain white card rows separated by a thin divider, each row showing only its dark title: "Refactor board module", "Draft ADR-004". These rows show no action labels.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Middle of the three equal board columns.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "Done" at its top, holding a vertical stack of two card rows separated by a thin divider; each card row shows only a small green circular check icon at the left followed by muted grey title text, no action labels. Card row titles, top to bottom: "Migrate todo list", "Set up CI".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Rightmost of the three equal board columns.
